excerpt: AgentX is a platform for building multi-agent AI teams, and its evaluation framework tests agents before and after deployment, pinpoints failures and suggests fixes. Pricing, alternatives and launch details.
content:
AgentX is a platform for building, evaluating and deploying AI agents. You build agents without code from your documents, websites and data, using the language model of your choice, and can organise them into multi-agent teams in which a manager agent hands work to specialist agents. Agents can be published to the web, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Teams, email, voice or an API. The company is AgentX Inc., according to its terms.

The launch on Product Hunt was its evaluation framework. It builds test sets from real data or production traces, runs an agent repeatedly to measure consistency across multi-step workflows, and scores results using several language models as judges. AgentX describes four layers of evaluation (task correctness, tool and API reliability, reasoning and consistency, and business impact), plus drift detection. Reports show every step of a run, pinpoint where an agent failed and propose a fix such as a change to its instructions, and evaluations can block a deployment that fails or promote one that passes. On self-serve plans, evaluation runs in demo mode; the full evaluation programme is part of the Enterprise plan. The launch went live on 22 June 2026, AgentX's third on Product Hunt, and finished #1 for the day with 504 points and 165 comments.

We have not tested AgentX ourselves. This page brings together its official site, its Product Hunt page and the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: Multi-agent AI platform with an evaluation framework that tests agents and suggests fixes

fit: are taking an AI agent to production and need regression tests and checks before each deployment
build multi-step or multi-agent workflows where results vary from run to run
are an agency deploying agents for clients under your own brand (Professional and Business plans include white-label)
not_fit: want the full evaluation framework on a self-serve plan: the pricing page lists evaluation as demo mode on Solo, Professional and Business
only need a simple chatbot, where an agent builder without evaluation may be enough
build agents purely in code and want an open-source library rather than a hosted platform

pricing.intro: AgentX has a free plan, self-serve plans priced monthly or yearly, and a custom Enterprise plan. Prices are in US dollars.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 1 workspace, up to 5 agents, 200 one-time credits, 1 seat, multi-agent workflows and API access

plans.name: Solo Builder
plans.detail: $490/year. Up to 25 agents, 5,000 credits a month, deploy to production, evaluation in demo mode

plans.name: Professional
plans.detail: $1,490/year. 10,000 credits a month, 2 seats, white-label deployment and client workspaces

plans.name: Business
plans.detail: $2,990/year. Unlimited agents, 20,000 credits a month, priority support and SLA

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Full agent evaluation programme, SSO, dedicated infrastructure, on-premise deployment, enterprise SLA

notes: Extra credits cost $10 per 1,000 on paid self-serve plans. Extra seats are $10 a month each on Professional and Business.
The full evaluation programme (risk mapping, custom datasets, multi-run testing, benchmarks, readiness assessment) is Enterprise only.
The pricing page's own cost examples quote the Professional plan at $249/mo, which differs from the $199 shown on the plan card; check before buying.

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: GPTBots.ai
items.what: No-code enterprise platform for AI agents, knowledge bases and workflows
items.difference: Focused on building and running enterprise agents for support and sales. AgentX puts evaluation and CI/CD at the centre.

items.name: Flowise
items.what: Open-source visual builder for AI agents and multi-agent flows
items.starts_at: Open source; see its pricing page
items.difference: Open source and self-hostable, but its site now says it is being sunset.

items.name: Claude by Anthropic
items.what: A family of AI models and apps
items.difference: A model and assistant, not an agent-evaluation platform. AgentX lets you use Claude and other models inside its agents.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Make and WRITER as alternatives.

x.none: We did not check X for this profile.

faq.a: A platform for building no-code AI agents and multi-agent teams, evaluating them and deploying them to channels such as the web, Slack, WhatsApp and an API. Its evaluation framework launched on Product Hunt on 22 June 2026.

faq.q: What does the evaluation framework do?
faq.a: It builds test sets from real data, runs agents repeatedly, scores them with several LLM judges across four layers (task correctness, tool reliability, reasoning and business impact), pinpoints failures and suggests fixes.
Yes. AgentX says you can block a deployment automatically if evaluations fail or promote it to production if they pass.
There is a free plan. Self-serve plans are Solo Builder at $49 a month, Professional at $199 and Business at $299, with Enterprise priced on request. Extra credits are $10 per 1,000.

faq.q: Is full evaluation included in self-serve plans?
faq.a: No. The pricing page lists evaluation in demo mode on Solo, Professional and Business; the full evaluation programme is part of Enterprise.

faq.q: Which frameworks does AgentX work with?
faq.a: Its site says it is compatible with LangChain, CrewAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic and Google ADK for observability.
